key_insight: Curiosity-0826-4B broadens zero-shot medical event prediction to pediatric populations and adult mortality, while reducing laboratory prediction error versus its predecessor.
clinical_relevance: A shared model could support multiple clinical and operational prediction tasks without separate task-specific training, but clinical utility remains unproven.
method: Trained on Epic Cosmos to simulate patient timelines and predict future events.
Expanded patient coverage and clinical event representations, including documented death.
Used scaling-law-guided pretraining and context extension to reach 4.3B parameters and a 16K context window.
evidence_signal: Evaluations reported 18–46% lower laboratory MAE than Curiosity-0226-1B, pediatric disease-event AUROCs of 0.742–0.852, and adult mortality AUROCs of 0.821–0.942.
watch_item: Deployment requires validation of local calibration, subgroup performance, generalization to new settings, and prospective clinical utility.
paper_title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
